quota_snapshot.warning: Snapshot only; re-read live quota before and after each task.

monitoring.action_when_threshold_crossed: Stop new work immediately; only record status and remaining items and notify the user.
monitoring.action_when_quota_unavailable: Mark quota unknown, pause new nonessential work, and notify the user.
limitations: Scheduled checks may be delayed and can queue while the current thread is busy; this is not strict real-time monitoring.
The automation only wakes the current thread and cannot forcibly stop work already running in other threads.
